Usage: photoc [global options] scrub <file|directory> --gps [--recursive]
       photoc scrub --help

Remove GPS metadata from JPEG copies

Status: available for JPEG files; writes .scrubbed copies without overwriting

Example:
  photoc scrub photo.jpg --gps
  photoc scrub ~/Pictures --gps --recursive

Options:
  --gps             Required; remove EXIF GPS tags
  --recursive       Include nested directories
